# Macmillan Learning Student Store

> A comprehensive textbook rental and purchase platform offering digital and physical course materials across multiple academic disciplines with savings up to 75%.

Macmillan Learning Student Store is the official retail destination for students to rent or buy textbooks and digital course materials from Macmillan Learning, a family-owned educational publisher. The store provides flexible format options including hardcover, paperback, loose-leaf, and e-books across dozens of academic disciplines.

## Shop by Format & Options

- [Save Up to 75% When You Rent Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/content/rent-and-save): Textbook rental options with up to 75% savings and free shipping benefits.
- [Textbook Formats & Options](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/content/formats): Guide to textbook formats: hardcover, paperback, loose-leaf, and digital options.
- [Student Store Promotional Deals](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/content/promotional-deals): Current promotional deals and discounts for textbook rentals and digital products.

## Textbooks by Discipline

- [Biology Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Biology): Biology textbooks covering majors, non-majors, labs, and biochemistry disciplines.
- [Chemistry Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Chemistry): Chemistry textbooks including biochemistry and chemistry labs for students.
- [Anatomy & Physiology Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Anatomy & Physiology): Anatomy & Physiology textbooks available for rent or purchase with free shipping.
- [Biochemistry Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Biochemistry): Biochemistry textbooks including Scientific Teaching Series for rent or purchase.
- [Economics Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Economics): Economics textbooks covering macro and microeconomics for student success.
- [English Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/English): English textbooks: composition, writing, business writing, and technical writing.
- [Communication Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Communication): Communication textbooks: public speaking, mass communication, journalism, and more.
- [Environmental Science Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Environmental Science): Environmental Science textbooks including chemistry and lab resources.
- [Geology Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Geology): Geology and Earth Science textbooks for rent or purchase with digital tools.
- [Astronomy Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Astronomy): Astronomy textbooks for rent or purchase with digital format options.
- [Geography Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Geography): Geography textbooks: human, physical geography, and GIS course materials.
- [Electrical Engineering Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/Electrical Engineering): Electrical Engineering textbooks for rent or purchase with digital learning tools.
- [College Success Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/discipline/College Success): College Success textbooks covering study skills and first-year seminars.
